notes.title: 1.1.2 - Leaderboards Update + Future Plans!
notes.notes: [p]It's been a little longer than expected, but finally got the Leaderboard Update tested and ready for the upcoming Summer Steam Sale![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155863/e34e5af23f9144b94d5bfffac83cd8ceba9a055c.png"][/img][/p][p]Go for the top time and top scores in your favourite levels or simply try and take on the Gauntlet to prove you're the best assassin out there![/p][p][/p][h3]Future Plans[/h3][p]I still plan on adding more to the game including a second gauntlet that's mostly finished, as well as a Temple Defence/Raid mode similar to something like Zombies mode from CoD with a few rogue-like elements thrown in as that's always a genre I've wanted to experiment with. [/p][p][/p][p]Progress will be a little slower than before due to transitioning to full-time hours with other work, but there are still plans for this game and any support goes a long way in helping with more resources to speed up development![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, and hope you enjoy! (P.S. if you have any feedback or want to follow the development, hop on down to our [url="https://discord.gg/XGWWVCHrrP"]Discord[/url])[/p]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE!🥳
notes.notes:
Everything's been submitted and Lightning Katana is finally ready for launch [b]Feburary 18th[/b] 🥳!

It's been almost a year of blood sweat and tears, but we're all excited to finally cross the finish line and show all the new things we've been working on since the demo including new levels, new mechanics, Hachiko's shop, and a hard as nails final boss with a few tricks up his sleeve 👀

Come check it all out on the 18th!

notes.title: Release date and full game coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155863/a905dc47a8f38675c0103d4f64891929b0f15c69.png[/img]
Merry Christmas season everyone! 

As of yesterday all of the levels and overall work for the final boss battle have finally been completed! 

Originally the plan was to release right after Thanksgiving in November, but the closer we got to finishing  the more ideas popped out at us and the more we wanted to add to the game to make it the best we possibly could with the time and resources we have. 

As of now we're just squeezing in a few more goodies and fun little surprises to give it a little extra heart  and flesh out some more story! Expect an announcement soon after the holidays for our final January release date!
